# Exhibitions and catalogue {#sec-exhibitions}

The CPS Wikibase records an exhibition (type Q3) and the catalogue (type Q205) that accompanied it. Works are linked to the exhibition with *Exhibited at* (P21) and to the catalogue with *Appears in catalogue* (P48). The catalogue statement can carry a *Scan page* qualifier (P49) that points to the page of a digitised copy.

```{python}
#| label: setup
from baldessari import cps, table
exh = cps.exhibitions()
cat = cps.catalogues()
works = cps.exhibited_works()
```

## Exhibition

```{python}
#| label: tbl-exhibitions
#| tbl-cap: "Exhibitions in the CPS Wikibase."
shown = exh[["qid", "label", "host", "start", "end", "works", "wikidata"]].copy()
shown["start"] = shown["start"].str[:10]
shown["end"] = shown["end"].str[:10]
shown.columns = ["ID", "Exhibition", "Host", "Start", "End", "Works", "Wikidata"]
table(shown)
```

## Catalogue

```{python}
#| label: tbl-catalogue
#| tbl-cap: "Catalogue records in the CPS Wikibase."
shown = cat[["qid", "title", "authors", "publisher", "published", "isbn", "dnbId"]].copy()
shown["published"] = shown["published"].str[:4]
shown.columns = ["ID", "Title", "Authors", "Publisher", "Year", "ISBN-13", "DNB ID"]
table(shown)
```

## Works and catalogue pages

```{python}
#| label: scan-coverage
n_total = len(works)
n_pages = int(works["page"].notna().sum())
```

**`{python} n_total`** works are linked to the exhibition. For **`{python} n_pages`** of them a scan page in the catalogue has been recorded so far.
